article_title: Giant whales move into Greenland waters as ice disappears

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: Melting sea ice is allowing giant whales to move into parts of Greenland where they were once rarely seen
Greenland has banned every kind of whale research
Whales are leaving all Greenland waters because there is no food
Scientists have discovered that humpbacks live only in tropical seas
tasks.correct_answer: Melting sea ice is allowing giant whales to move into parts of Greenland where they were once rarely seen
tasks.explanation_hebrew: היעלמות קרח הים פותחת אזורים צפוניים שבעבר כמעט לא היו נגישים ללווייתנים גדולים.

tasks.prompt: How did reported humpback sightings change between 2007 and 2024?
options: They fell from 150 to seven
They stayed at about seven each year
They rose from seven to about 150 ship-based sightings
They increased from 150 to 1,500
tasks.correct_answer: They rose from seven to about 150 ship-based sightings
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה משווה שבע תצפיות ב־2007 לכ־150 תצפיות מכלי שיט ב־2024.

tasks.prompt: What does “influx” mean in the article's description of whales entering the region?
options: A seasonal layer of sea ice
A large arrival or movement into an area
A method of counting animals from the air
A shortage of food in the ocean
tasks.correct_answer: A large arrival or movement into an area
tasks.explanation_hebrew: influx פירושו נהירה או כניסה של מספר גדול של בעלי חיים לאזור.

tasks.prompt: Which kinds of evidence did researchers combine to understand the change?
options: Only laboratory tests on sea water
Satellite photos of towns and road maps
Old hunting laws and tourist advertisements
Systematic surveys, ship sightings and local testimony
tasks.correct_answer: Systematic surveys, ship sightings and local testimony
tasks.explanation_hebrew: החוקרים שילבו סקרים שיטתיים, תצפיות מכלי שיט ועדויות מקומיות.

tasks.prompt: Why can reduced sea ice make northern Greenland waters more attractive to humpback whales?
options: It opens access to feeding areas and changing prey
It turns whales into land animals
It removes the need for whales to eat
It guarantees that no Arctic species will be affected
tasks.correct_answer: It opens access to feeding areas and changing prey
tasks.explanation_hebrew: פחות קרח מאפשר גישה לאזורי האכלה, ושינויים בזמינות המזון עשויים למשוך לווייתנים.

tasks.prompt: In this article, what is a “sighting”?
options: A prediction about next year's ice
A protected breeding area
An occasion when a whale is seen
A device attached to a whale
tasks.correct_answer: An occasion when a whale is seen
tasks.explanation_hebrew: sighting הוא מקרה שבו צופים בלווייתן ורושמים את נוכחותו.

tasks.prompt: Give two signs from the article that giant whales are becoming more common farther north in Greenland.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שתי ראיות קונקרטיות מן הכתבה.
expected_points: The rise from seven humpbacks seen in 2007 to about 150 ship-based sightings in 2024
Systematic aerial or ship surveys recorded whales in areas where they were historically rare
Local testimony also reports more whales
The observations show movement into previously ice-blocked northern waters

tasks.prompt: Summarise how climate change, sea ice and food availability are connected to the whales' movement.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך להציג שרשרת סיבה ותוצאה ברורה.
expected_points: Less ice makes previously inaccessible waters reachable
Marine food availability and distribution are changing
Opportunistic humpback whales follow feeding opportunities
Their range therefore expands farther north

tasks.prompt: Why do scientists need both systematic surveys and local testimony rather than relying on one source alone?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר כיצד מקורות המידע משלימים זה את זה.
expected_points: Surveys provide comparable and organised observations
Local residents and crews observe the area across seasons and years
One method can detect changes missed by another
Combining sources strengthens confidence in the conclusion

tasks.prompt: Explain one benefit and one possible ecological risk of giant whales moving into a new Arctic habitat. Use evidence or reasoning from the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג תועלת וסיכון אפשרי ולהבחין בין עובדה להסקה.
expected_points: New feeding habitat may help humpback whales exploit available prey
Their arrival reflects greater access as ice retreats
Large whales consume substantial amounts of food
They may compete with or displace ice-adapted marine mammals
The Arctic ecosystem is sensitive to rapid change
